trickyParts: The 5 s timer starts at postMessage, before the hold report; the hold is an expect.poll bounded by the 15 s expect timeout, and the samples take about 0.6-1 s inside the 5 s window (observed passes in all four projects).

A one-shot page-thread block queued with setTimeout(…, 0) does not fail a sample: the next page.evaluate waits behind it and starts its 100 ms timer afterwards. A repeating block (setInterval) is what fails it.
